压缩然后合并：从多个 LoRA 到一个低阶适配器Compress then Merge: From Multiple LoRAs into One Low-Rank Adapter

Zhengbao He    Ruiqi Ding    Zhehao Huang    Ruikai Yang    Tao Li    Xiaolin Huang
摘要Abstract

低阶自适应 (LoRA) 可实现基础模型的参数高效专业化，但特定于任务的适配器的激增会分散许多适配器的功能，使重用和部署变得复杂。 我们研究的问题是Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient specialization of foundation models, but the proliferation of task-specific adapters fragments capabilities across many adapters, complicating reuse and deployment. We study the problem of合并mergingTTLoRA 进入单一等级 -LoRAs into a single rank-rr洛拉LoRA，从而保留低阶结构的好处。 现有的合并然后压缩管道将等级约束视为事后的想法：它们在完整的参数空间中合并适配器， 然后将合并结果压缩排名, thereby preserving the benefits of low-rank structure. Existing Merge-then-Compress pipelines treat the rank constraint as an afterthought: they merge adapters in the full parameter space, then compress the merged result to rankrr通过截断的 SVD。 然而，全参数合并可能会破坏低秩结构，使得后续压缩很难恢复有效的秩。via truncated SVD. However, full-parameter merging may destroy the low-rank structure, making it difficult for subsequent compression to recover an effective rank-rr洛拉。 我们提出压缩然后合并（CtM），这是一种强制排序的反向管道LoRA. We propose Compress-then-Merge (CtM), a reversed pipeline that enforces the rank-rr瓶颈bottleneck之前before合并：CtM 计算共享merging: CtM computes sharedrr仅使用LoRA权重捕获跨适配器公共结构的维子空间，将每个适配器投影到共享子空间中以获得-dimensional subspaces using only the LoRA weights to capture cross-adapter common structure, projects each adapter into the shared subspaces to obtainr×rr\times r坐标，然后在这个缩小的空间中应用标准合并规则。 CtM 保证排名-coordinates, and then applies standard merging rules in this reduced space. CtM guarantees a rank-rrLoRA 通过构造，避免了事后截断，并能够在由连接的 LoRA 因子跨越的核心空间中进行高效计算。 跨多个模型和任务的实验表明，CtM 始终优于现有的单 LoRA 输出基线，同时缩小了与全参数合并方法的性能差距。LoRA by construction, avoiding post-hoc truncation, and enables efficient computation in the core space spanned by concatenated LoRA factors. Experiments across multiple models and tasks show that CtM consistently outperforms existing single-LoRA-output baselines while narrowing the performance gap to full-parameter merging methods.

1 简介Introduction

低阶适应（LoRA）Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)(Hu et al., 2022)及其变体and its variants(Wang et al., 2024b; Li et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2025)已成为参数高效微调（PEFT）的常见选择，使从业者能够以最小的开销专门化大型基础模型。这一成功创建了一个快速发展的特定任务 LoRA 适配器生态系统，在 HuggingFace 等平台上广泛共享have become a common choice for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), enabling practitioners to specialize large foundation models with minimal overhead. This success has created a rapidly growing ecosystem of task-specific LoRA adapters, widely shared on platforms such as HuggingFace(Team, 2024)。 然而，这也分散了许多适配器的功能，导致难以有效地重用、维护和部署它们。因此，整合多个 LoRA 的知识已成为一个重要的实际问题和日益增长的研究焦点. However, this also fragments capabilities across many adapters, making it difficult to reuse, maintain, and deploy them efficiently. As a result, consolidating knowledge from multiple LoRAs has become an important practical problem and a growing research focus(Panariello et al., 2025; Hu et al., 2025).

模型合并Model merging(Yadav et al., 2023; Choi et al., 2024; Yu et al., 2024)提供了一种将多个 LoRA 整合到单个模型中的自然机制。 现有方法provides a natural mechanism for consolidating multiple LoRAs into a single model. Existing approaches(Marczak et al., 2025; Stoica et al., 2025)通常将 LoRA 合并到完整的参数空间中，产生全尺寸的权重更新而不是低阶适配器。 这牺牲了 LoRA 的关键优势，例如模块化和易于重用。 例如，如果稍后想要将合并模型适应有限硬件上的新域，则合并更新需要保留单个 LoRA 适配器。 在本文中，我们重点关注更具挑战性和实用性的合并设置，最近由often merge LoRAs in the full parameter space, producing a full-sized weight update rather than a low-rank adapter. This sacrifices LoRA’s key advantages such as modularity and easy reuse. For example, if one later wants to adapt the merged model to a new domain on limited hardware, the merged update needs to remain a single LoRA adapter. In this paper, we focus on a more challenging and practical merging setting, discussed recently byTang et al., 2025: 给定: givenTTLoRA 适配器（从相同的基础模型训练，注入相同的模块，并共享相同的等级），我们的目标是将它们合并到LoRA adapters (trained from the same base model, injected into the same modules, and sharing the same rank), we aim to merge them into1 个 LoRA 适配器one LoRA adapter有目标排名with target rankrr，即保持 LoRA 效率的低等级更新，同时集成跨任务的功能。, i.e., a low-rank update that preserves LoRA’s efficiency while integrating capabilities across tasks.

在旨在输出单个 LoRA 的合并方法中，广泛采用的基线Among merging methods that aim to output a single LoRA, a widely adopted baseline(Tang et al., 2025; Goddard et al., 2024)遵循一个follows a合并然后压缩Merge-then-Compress(MtC) 管道：它首先将多个 LoRA 合并为一个全尺寸的高等级更新(MtC) pipeline: it first merges multiple LoRAs into a full-sized, high-rank updateΔ​Wmerged\Delta W_{\mathrm{merged}}，然后将其压缩为等级 -, and then compresses it into a rank-rr通过截断 SVD 的矩阵。 这种设计使等级约束成为事后的想法：信息在合并过程中不受约束，但只有一小部分子集在以后的压缩中幸存下来。 从 Frobenius 范数测量的近似误差来看，截断 SVD 确实是最优的。然而，弗罗贝尼乌斯范数并不总是与跨任务的平均性能保持一致，这可能导致性能下降和难以控制的多任务权衡。 例如，LoRA 更新的规模可能会有很大差异matrix via truncated SVD. This design makes the rank constraint an afterthought: information is unconstrained during merging, but only a small subset survives the later compression. In the view of approximation error measured by Frobenius norm, truncated SVD is indeed optimal. However, the Frobenius norm is not always aligned with average performance across tasks, which can lead to degraded performance and hard-to-control multi-task trade-offs. For example, LoRA updates can vary dramatically in scale(Zheng et al., 2025)，并且基于 SVD 的压缩往往有利于大范数任务更新。这可能会导致所有任务的性能下降，但小范数任务的损失会更大（如图所示）, and SVD-based compression tends to favor large-norm task updates. 为了获得共享子空间，我们在重新缩放的输入 LoRA 更新上优化重建目标，而不使用辅助数据。这会产生左/右子空间的一对基向量。 至关重要的是，我们引入了一种重新缩放机制来避免幅度优势，确保学习的子空间反映所有任务中广泛有用的方向。 一旦建立了共享空间，每个适配器都会投影到其上并由一个紧凑的表示To obtain the shared subspaces, we optimize a reconstruction objective over the rescaled input LoRA updates, without using auxiliary data. 2 相关工作Related Work

模型合并。Model merging.模型合并将多个独立训练的模型合并为一个模型。大多数工作Model merging consolidates multiple independently trained models into a single model. Most work(Matena and Raffel, 2022; Jin et al., 2023; Nguyen et al., 2025; Jang et al., 2024)专注于从相同基础检查点微调的同源模型，其中参数变化是任务向量/矩阵focuses on homologous models fine-tuned from the same base checkpoint, where the parameter change is a task vector/matrixΔ​θ=θft−θbase\Delta\theta=\theta_{\mathrm{ft}}-\theta_{\mathrm{base}}。 任务算术（TA，. Task arithmetic (TA,Ilharco et al., 2023）表明简单的平均可以产生多任务模型，以及逐元素启发式方法，例如 TIES) shows that simple averaging can yield a multitask model, and element-wise heuristics such as TIES(Yadav et al., 2023)和敢于and DARE(Yu et al., 2024)通过修剪、稀疏化和符号冲突解决进一步减少干扰。 最近的工作研究从矩阵/子空间视图合并，例如 TSVfurther reduce interference via trimming, sparsification, and sign-conflict resolution. Recent work studies merging from a matrix/subspace view, e.g., TSV(Gargiulo et al., 2025), 异丙醇, Iso-C(Marczak et al., 2025)，和购物车, and CART(Choi et al., 2024)，但这些方法主要是为全参数更新和输出密集合并权重而设计的。, but these methods are primarily designed for full-parameter updates and output dense merged weights.

LoRA 的合并方法。Merging methods for LoRA.越来越多的工作研究如何合并 LoRA 适配器。 基于对齐的方法，例如 KnOTSA growing body of work studies how to merge LoRA adapters. Alignment-based methods such as KnOTS(Stoica et al., 2025)和核心空间and CoreSpace(Panariello et al., 2025)构建无损基础以将适配器映射到公共坐标系中以进行后续合并。 然而，直接合并可以产生具有更高等级的合并更新，因此它们通常依赖于额外的基于 SVD 的压缩步骤来生成固定等级的合并结果build lossless bases to map adapters into a common coordinate system for subsequent merging. However, directly merging can produce a merged update with much higher rank, so they typically rely on an additional SVD-based compression step to generate a fixed-rank merged result(Tang et al., 2025; Goddard et al., 2024)。 这种事后截断可能与在等级约束下保留平均多任务效用不一致。 一些作品也旨在直接生产低等级适配器，包括 LoRA-LEGO. This post-hoc truncation may be misaligned with preserving average multi-task utility under the rank constraint. Several works also aim to produce low-rank adapters directly, including LoRA-LEGO(Zhao et al., 2025), 鲁棒合并, RobustMerge(Zeng et al., 2025)、 和 Iso-CTS, and Iso-CTS(Marczak et al., 2025).

超越 LoRA 的免培训整合。Beyond training-free consolidation of LoRA.除了免训练合并之外，一些方法还学习使用辅助数据来选择、组合或提取多个 LoRA 以合并多个 LoRABeyond training-free merging, some methods learn to select, compose, or distill multiple LoRAs using auxiliary data to consolidate multiple LoRAs(Huang et al., 2023; Wang et al., 2024a; Hu et al., 2025; Alipour and Amiri, 2025; Chen et al., 2025)，而其他人保留多个 LoRA 专家并训练路由器在推理时动态选择适配器, while others keep multiple LoRA experts and train a router to dynamically select adapters at inference time(Buehler and Buehler, 2024; Feng et al., 2024)。 这些方法与我们的方法是互补的：它们依赖于训练和/或多专家推理，而我们专注于直接合并到单个固定秩 LoRA 中，无需任何训练。. These approaches are complementary to ours: they rely on training and/or multi-expert inference, whereas we focus on directly merging into a single fixed-rank LoRA without any training.

从多个 LoRA 中提取子空间。Subspace extraction from multiple LoRAs.有几项工作从 LoRA 适配器集合中提取了共享的低维结构。 先压缩后服务Several works extract a shared low-dimensional structure from collections of LoRA adapters. Compress-then-Serve(Gabrielsson et al., 2025)将大量 LoRA 联合压缩到共享坐标/库中，以实现高效的多适配器服务。 特征LoRAxjointly compresses large numbers of LoRAs into shared coordinates/bases to enable efficient multi-adapter serving. EigenLoRAx(Kaushik et al., 2025b)回收预训练的适配器来识别可重复使用的主要子空间，以用很少的附加参数加速对新任务的适应。 这些作品侧重于表示、服务或重用recycles pretrained adapters to identify a principal subspace that can be reused to accelerate adaptation to new tasks with very few additional parameters. 3.3 MtC 的局限性Limitations of MtC

MtC 的主要结构问题是仅强制执行等级约束The main structural issue of MtC is that the rank constraint is enforced only之后after合并。合并步骤可以自由地积累各个方向的信息，并且随后的方程中的截断SVD。merging. The merge step is free to accumulate information in all directions, and the subsequent truncated SVD in Eq.1只保留位于顶部的组件keeps only the components that lie in the top-rr奇异子空间并丢弃与其正交的所有内容。尽管这种基于 SVD 的压缩对于最小化 Frobenius 重建误差而言是最佳选择，但该标准通常与最终目标（平均跨任务性能）不一致。singular subspace and discards everything orthogonal to it. Although this SVD-based compression is optimal for minimizing Frobenius reconstruction error, this criterion often misaligns with the ultimate goal: average cross-task performance.

在这种事后约束下，合并结果谱中的任何系统偏差都直接决定了哪些方向可以生存Under this post-hoc constraint, any systematic bias in the merged result’s spectrum directly determines which directions survive inΔ​WLoRA\Delta W_{\mathrm{LoRA}}。 偏差的一个主要来源是不同任务之间 LoRA 更新幅度的巨大差异. A major source of bias is the substantial variation of LoRA update magnitudes across tasks(Zheng et al., 2025)：大规格适配器往往占据主导地位: large-norm adapters tend to dominate the spectrum ofΔ​Wmerged\Delta W_{\mathrm{merged}}，因此截断的 SVD 将秩容量集中在这些主导方向上，从而系统地抑制来自小范数适配器的低能量、未对准的分量。 一种更微妙的故障模式是 LoRA 训练期间可能会出现“入侵者维度”, so truncated SVD concentrates rank capacity on these dominant directions, thereby systematically suppresses lower-energy, misaligned components from small-norm adapters. A more subtle failure mode is that “intruder dimensions” may emerge during LoRA training(Shuttleworth et al., 2024): 大震级large-magnitude看似与下游准确性关系不大的方向，但却严重削弱了预先训练的知识保留，可能使后续合并变得复杂。 由于它们也表现为高能方向，因此与真正有用的成分无法区分，因此很可能被截断的 SVD 保留下来。directions that appear weakly related to downstream accuracy yet substantially erode pretrained knowledge retention, potentially complicating subsequent merging. Since they also appear as high-energy directions, they are indistinguishable from genuinely useful components and are therefore likely to be preserved by truncated SVD.

因此，MTC 可以轻松地将等级容量过度分配给一些高量级或弱任务对齐方向，从而将其他小规范、与任务相关的更新推到外部As a consequence, MtC can easily over-allocate rank capacity to a few high-magnitude or weakly task-aligned directions, pushing other small-norm, task-relevant updates outside therr维子空间。这可能会导致每个任务的权衡不均匀且脆弱：一些任务保存完好，而另一些任务则遭受不成比例的截断引起的退化，如图所示-dimensional subspace. This can lead to uneven and brittle per-task trade-offs: some tasks are well preserved, while others suffer disproportionate truncation-induced degradation, as illustrated empirically in Figure2.

4 压缩然后合并 (CtM) 管道Compress-then-Merge (CtM) Pipeline

将多个 LoRA 合并为一个等级 -Merging multiple LoRAs into a single rank-rr适配器不可避免地会导致信息丢失：最终版本之外的任何组件adapter inevitably incurs information loss: any component outside the finalrr维子空间必须被丢弃。在 MtC 中，这种损失仅强加于-dimensional subspace must be discarded. In MtC, this loss is imposed only之后after合并，因此基本上不受控制。截断子空间由合并更新的频谱决定，而不是由跨任务结构决定。受此启发，我们移动了子空间选择merging and is therefore largely uncontrolled. The truncation subspace is determined by the spectrum of the merged update rather than by cross-task structure. Motivated by this, we move the subspace choice预先upfront并提出and propose the压缩然后合并 (CtM)Compress-then-Merge (CtM)管道。 CtM 明确学习共享pipeline. CtM explicitly learns sharedrr将每个 LoRA 投影到的维度子空间-dimensional subspaces to project each LoRA intor×rr\times r后续合并的坐标。 因此，合并的结果在构造上是低等级的，从而减少了任务相关信息的丢失并消除了额外的事后压缩步骤的需要。coordinates for subsequent merging. The merged result is thus low-rank by construction, mitigating the loss of task-relevant information and removing the need for an additional post-hoc compression step.

5.3 分析Analysis

CtM 从能量和功能角度学习更有效和平衡的子空间。CtM learns a more effective and balanced subspace from both energy and functional perspectives.为了比较不同合并管道获得的子空间的保真度，我们提取合并结果的左/右子空间To compare the fidelity of the subspaces obtained by different merging pipelines, we extract the left/right subspaces of the merged resultΔ​WLoRA\Delta W_{\mathrm{LoRA}}通过thin SVD，将每个任务LoRA投影到这些子空间上以获得其投影LoRA。然后，我们从两个互补的角度评估预计的 LoRA：它们保留了多少参数空间能量，以及它们在功能层面上保留了多少任务效用（详细信息参见附录）via thin SVD, and project each task LoRA onto these subspaces to obtain its projected LoRA. We then evaluate the projected LoRAs from two complementary perspectives: how much parameter-space energy they retain, and how much task utility they preserve at the functional level (details in AppendixD.1）。图). Figure3表明 CtM 从两个角度都实现了更高的平均保留率，并且在数据集中表现出显着更低的方差。这表明 CtM 不仅提高了保留子空间的平均保真度，而且在任务之间更均匀地分配固定排名预算。特别是，功能保留结果表明，CtM 对于最坏情况的任务崩溃更加稳健，而 MtC 的事后截断可能会严重丢弃较小或不太占主导地位的适配器的任务相关方向。通过在合并之前选择共享子空间，CtM 减轻了这种不平衡，并在固定秩约束下更忠实地保留了任务效用。shows that CtM achieves higher average retention from both perspectives and exhibits substantially lower variance across datasets. This indicates that CtM does not merely improve the mean fidelity of the retained subspace, but also allocates the fixed rank budget more evenly across tasks. In particular, the functional-retention results suggest that CtM is more robust to worst-case task collapse, while MtC’s post-hoc truncation may severely discard task-relevant directions for smaller or less dominant adapters. By selecting the shared subspace before merging, CtM mitigates this imbalance and preserves task utility more faithfully under the fixed-rank constraint.

6 结论Conclusion

我们研究合并We study the merging ofTT在等级约束下将 LoRA 适配器转换为单个 LoRALoRA adapters into a single LoRA under a rank constraintrr。 我们首先表明，现有的 MtC 管道在合并期间忽略了等级约束，这可能会错误分配有限的等级预算并损害整体多任务效用。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了压缩然后合并（CtM），这是一种强制排名约束的反向管道. We first show that existing MtC pipelines neglect the rank constraint during merging, which can misallocate the limited rank budget and hurt overall multi-task utility. To address this, we propose Compress-then-Merge (CtM), a reversed pipeline that enforces the rank constraint之前before合并。 具体来说，CtM 首先计算共享merging. Specifically, CtM first computes sharedrr仅使用 LoRA 权重的维子空间，将每个适配器投影为紧凑的-dimensional subspaces using only the LoRA weights, projects each adapter into compactr×rr{\times}r坐标，然后直接合并坐标。 在多任务视觉和语言任务中，CtM 持续改进了之前的单 LoRA 输出基线，并显着缩小了与全权重方法的差距。 最后，CtM 还可以与核心空间框架相结合实现高效计算，从而在不牺牲合并性能的情况下实现显着的加速。 总之，CtM 提供了一种在严格的等级约束下将多个 LoRA 合并为一个 LoRA 的有效策略。coordinates, and then merges the coordinates directly. Across multi-task vision and language tasks, CtM consistently improves over prior single-LoRA-output baselines and narrows the gap to full-weight methods significantly. Finally, CtM also enables an efficient computation combined with the core-space framework, yielding substantial speedups without sacrificing merged performance. In summary, CtM provides an effective strategy for merging multiple LoRAs into one LoRA under a strict rank constraint.

局限性Limitations

CtM 旨在将多个适配器整合到单个固定秩 LoRA 中，其有效性取决于跨任务更新的共享结构的存在，这些更新可以由公共低秩子空间捕获。当任务高度正交时，任何受限于输出单个固定秩 LoRA 的方法都将不可避免地遭受信息丢失，而 CtM 无法消除这一根本瓶颈。在这种情况下，更高的秩预算或更具表现力的 PEFT 参数化以获得更高的秩CtM is designed for the setting of consolidating multiple adapters into a single fixed-rank LoRA, and its effectiveness depends on the existence of shared structure across task updates that can be captured by a common low-rank subspace. When tasks are highly orthogonal, any method constrained to output a single fixed-rank LoRA will inevitably suffer from information loss, and CtM cannot eliminate this fundamental bottleneck. In such cases, a higher rank budget or a more expressive PEFT parameterization for higher rank(Raje et al., 2025; Huang et al., 2025; Singhal et al., 2026)可能需要。此外，CtM在实践中仍然需要选择超参数，例如目标排名、重新加权系数和基础合并规则。开发针对 CtM 坐标空间的更具适应性的策略和合并规则仍然是未来工作的重要方向。may be required. Moreover, CtM still requires selecting hyperparameters in practice, such as the target rank, the reweighting coefficient, and the base merge rule. Developing more adaptive strategies and merge rules tailored to the CtM coordinate space remains an important direction for future work.

影响报告Impact Statement

CtM旨在提高合并和部署多个LoRA适配器的效率，这在受存储、服务和管理成本限制的应用场景中可能很有价值。然而，在实际使用中，此类方法仍然涉及额外的超参数选择和计算开销，在部署便利性方面还有改进的空间。此外，将多个适配器的功能合并到单个模型中可能会使模型行为更难以追溯到特定数据源或原始适配器提供商，从而给版权归属和模型安全审计带来挑战。此类方法还可用于组合多个具有潜在风险功能的专用适配器。因此，实际部署应辅之以适当的源头管理和安全治理措施。CtM is intended to improve the efficiency of merging and deploying multiple LoRA adapters, which may be valuable in application scenarios constrained by storage, serving, and management costs. However, in practical use, such methods still involve additional hyperparameter selection and computational overhead, leaving room for improvement in deployment convenience. In addition, merging the capabilities of multiple adapters into a single model can make it more difficult to trace model behavior back to specific data sources or original adapter providers, thereby raising challenges for copyright attribution and model safety auditing. Such methods may also be used to combine multiple specialized adapters with potentially risky capabilities. Therefore, practical deployment should be accompanied by appropriate source management and safety governance measures.

B.1 与基于对齐的基线的差异。Difference with Alignment-based Baselines.

基于对齐的方法首先将每个 LoRA 更新映射到共享坐标系Alignment-based methods first map each LoRA update to a shared coordinate systemR(t)=Proj​(Δ​W(t))R^{(t)}=\mathrm{Proj}(\Delta W^{(t)})，将它们合并得到, merge them to obtainRmergedR_{\mathrm{merged}}，并重建, and reconstructΔ​Wmerged=Recons​(Rmerged)\Delta W_{\mathrm{merged}}=\mathrm{Recons}(R_{\mathrm{merged}})。诺特. KnOTS(Stoica et al., 2025)连接完整更新并执行 SVD 以获得每个任务对齐的矩阵concatenates full updates and performs SVD to obtain per-task aligned matrices[Δ​W(1),…,Δ​W(T)]=U​Σ​[V(1);…;V(T)]⊤[\Delta W^{(1)},\ldots,\Delta W^{(T)}]=U\Sigma[V^{(1)};\ldots;V^{(T)}]^{\top}，然后合并, then merges{V(t)}\{V^{(t)}\}并用共享的重建and reconstructs with the shared(U,Σ)(U,\Sigma)。核心空间. CoreSpace(Panariello et al., 2025)用途usesCore(t)=UB⊤​Δ​W(t)​VA\mathrm{Core}^{(t)}=U_{B}^{\top}\Delta W^{(t)}V_{A}（等式。(Eq.9) 作为) asR(t)R^{(t)}.

这些投影旨在保留信息，即我们可以有These projections are designed to be information-preserving, i.e., we can haveΔ​W(t)=Recons​(Proj​(Δ​W(t)))\Delta W^{(t)}=\mathrm{Recons}(\mathrm{Proj}(\Delta W^{(t)}))。这就是为什么我们可以使用无损 CoreSpace 坐标来加速解决 CtM 子空间学习目标（第 2 节）。. That’s why we can use the lossless CoreSpace coordinates to accelerate solving the CtM subspace-learning objective (Sec.4.3）。然而，由于预测保留了所有信息，因此它们不会强加排名-). However, since the projections preserves all information, they do not impose a rank-rr瓶颈，获得单一排名bottleneck, obtaining a single rank-rrLoRA 通常仍然需要事后截断（例如，式 1）。LoRA typically still requires post-hoc truncation (e.g., Eq.1）。相比之下，CtM 学习有损投影瓶颈，从而通过构造保证秩约束。). In contrast, CtM learns a lossy projection bottleneck and thus guarantees the rank constraint by construction.

C.1 数据集和模型Datasets and Models

关注 KnOTSFollowing KnOTS(Stoica et al., 2025)和核心空间and CoreSpace(Panariello et al., 2025)，我们评估视觉任务和 NLI 任务的合并方法。, we evaluate merging methods on both vision tasks and NLI tasks.

模型。Models.

为了重现性，我们采用 HuggingFace 上公开发布的 KnOTS LoRA 适配器作为我们的特定任务专家。对于视觉任务，我们使用 CLIP ViT-B/32 作为基础模型，并且 LoRA 进行排序训练For reproducibility, we adopt the publicly released KnOTS LoRA adapters on HuggingFace as our task-specific experts. The adapters are injected into the attention projection modules{q_proj、k_proj、v_proj、out_proj}{q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, out_proj}无论它们出现在骨干中的任何地方。使用 CLIP 文本编码器的数据集类标签的文本嵌入构建固定的分类头（即，通过使用文本编码器对类名称进行编码来获得分类器权重）。 对于 NLI 任务，我们使用 LLaMA3-8B 作为基础模型，并使用相同的视觉任务配置（即wherever they appear in the backbone. A fixed classification head is constructed using the text embeddings of the dataset class labels of the CLIP text encoder (i.e., the classifier weights are obtained by encoding class names with the text encoder). For NLI tasks, we use the LLaMA3-8B as the base model and the LoRAs are trained with the same configuration of vision task (the输出项目out_proj在 LLaMA3-8B 中是in LLaMA3-8B iso_项目o_proj). (Stoica et al., 2025)使用序列分类头（3 路 NLI）实例化模型 抱脸instantiates the model with a sequence-classification head (3-way NLI) using HuggingFace序列分类自动模型AutoModelForSequenceClassification。在合并过程中，只有 LLaMA 主干（与 LoRA 层）被合并；每个数据集的评估使用其相应的特定于任务的分类头（例如 二进制 NLI 数据集，缺失的标签被屏蔽）。. During merging, only the LLaMA backbone (with LoRA layers) is merged; evaluation on each dataset uses its corresponding task-specific classification head (for binary NLI datasets, the missing label is masked).

数据集。Datasets.

对于视觉任务，我们采用以下八个数据集，涵盖细粒度识别、纹理、遥感、交通标志、数字和场景分类。For vision task, we adopt the following eight datasets spanning fine-grained recognition, textures, remote sensing, traffic signs, digits, and scene classification.

  • •

    汽车Cars (Krause et al., 2013)：区分汽车类别的细粒度识别基准。: a fine-grained recognition benchmark for distinguishing car categories.

  • •

    可描述纹理数据集 (DTD)Describable Textures Dataset (DTD) (Cimpoi et al., 2014)：由人类可描述的纹理属性（例如“条纹”、“点”）组织的纹理分类数据集。: a texture classification dataset organized by human-describable texture attributes (e.g., “striped”, “dotted”).

  • •

    欧洲卫星公司EuroSAT (Helber et al., 2018)：根据 Sentinel-2 图像构建的遥感土地利用/土地覆盖分类数据集。: a remote-sensing land-use/land-cover classification dataset built from Sentinel-2 imagery.

  • •

    德国交通标志识别基准 (GTSRB)German Traffic Sign Recognition Benchmark (GTSRB) (Stallkamp et al., 2012)：交通标志识别基准，具有不同成像条件下真实的德国道路标志。: a traffic-sign recognition benchmark featuring real-world German road signs under diverse imaging conditions.

  • •

    MNIST (LeCun et al., 1998)：经典的手写数字分类数据集，广泛用于基准识别方法。: a classic handwritten digit classification dataset widely used for benchmarking recognition methods.

  • •

    西北工业大学-RESISC45NWPU-RESISC45 (Cheng et al., 2017)：具有大量类内变异和类间相似性的遥感场景分类数据集。: a remote-sensing scene classification dataset with substantial intra-class variation and inter-class similarity.

  • •

    太阳397SUN397 (Xiao et al., 2016)：涵盖广泛的室内和室外环境的大规模场景识别数据集。: a large-scale scene recognition dataset covering a broad range of indoor and outdoor environments.

  • •

    街景门牌号 (SVHN)Street View House Numbers (SVHN) (Netzer et al., 2011)：基于 Google 街景中的门牌号图像的数字分类基准。: a digit classification benchmark based on house-number images from Google Street View.

对于 NLI 任务，我们采用以下六个数据集：For NLI task, we adopt the following six datasets:

  • •

    SNLI (Bowman et al., 2015)：一个大型 NLI 句子对数据集，标记为蕴涵、中性或矛盾，主要由图像说明构建。: a large NLI dataset of sentence pairs labeled as entailment, neutral, or contradiction, constructed mainly from image captions.

  • •

    MNLI (Williams et al., 2018)：多流派 NLI 基准测试，具有与 SNLI 相同的三向标签，旨在测试跨域泛化。: a multi-genre NLI benchmark with the same three-way labels as SNLI, designed to test cross-domain generalization.

  • •

    西克SICK (Marelli et al., 2014)：文本蕴含和语义相关性的句子对基准。: a sentence-pair benchmark for textual entailment and semantic relatedness.

  • •

    QNLI (Wang et al., 2019)：通过重铸 SQuAD 创建的二进制 GLUE 任务: a binary GLUE task created by recasting SQuAD(Rajpurkar et al., 2016)将问题回答转化为句对推理（蕴涵与非蕴涵）。question answering into sentence-pair inference (entailment vs. not-entailment).

  • •

    即时通讯RTE (Wang et al., 2019)：GLUE 中的二进制文本蕴含任务由多个 RTE 挑战数据集组装而成。: a binary textual entailment task in GLUE assembled from multiple RTE challenge datasets.

  • •

    赛泰尔SCITAIL (Khot et al., 2018)：根据多项选择 QA 构建的科学领域蕴涵数据集，将检索到的科学句子（前提）与问答假设配对。: a science-domain entailment dataset built from multiple-choice QA, pairing retrieved science sentences (premises) with question–answer hypotheses.

More importantly, CtM exhibits substantially lower variance across datasets, suggesting a more balanced and stable coverage of task directions. In contrast, MtC shows significant collapse on several tasks, despite comparable coverage on others, reflecting its sensitivity to scale and truncation.

功能评估得出一致的结论。 CtM 提高了平均准确度保留率，并显着提高了最差任务的保留率。这表明 CtM 不仅仅 保留更多的参数空间能量；它还保留了下游性能所需的与任务相关的组件。 总体而言，能量和功能结果共同表明 CtM 学习了一个可以更好地保留多任务的子空间 固定等级约束下的结构和任务效用。The functional evaluation leads to a consistent conclusion. CtM improves the mean accuracy retention, and raises the worst-task retention significantly. This shows that CtM does not merely preserve more parameter-space energy; it also retains the task-relevant components needed for downstream performance. Overall, the energy and functional results jointly demonstrate that CtM learns a subspace that better preserves multi-task structure and task utility under a fixed rank constraint.

除了 CLIP 结果之外，我们还对 NLI 进行了相同的功能投影测试，如图所示Beyond the CLIP results, we further conduct the same functional projection test on NLI, as reported in Figure6。 从平均性能、方差和最坏情况稳健性的角度来看，结论仍然一致：CtM 提高了平均功能保留率. The conclusion remains consistent from the perspectives of mean performance, variance, and worst-case robustness: CtM improves the mean functional retention from93.24%93.24\% to 96.43%96.43\%，减少了跨任务标准偏差，更重要的是，大大提高了最差任务的保留率, reduces the cross-task standard deviation, and, more importantly, substantially improves the worst-task retention from66.86%66.86\% to 91.13%91.13\%。具体来说，MTC 在 SICK 上遭受了急剧崩溃，这既降低了其平均保留率，又增加了其跨任务可变性。相比之下，CtM 避免了如此严重的任务崩溃，并在任务之间产生更稳定的保留配置文件。这一结果表明，CtM 学习到的子空间在固定秩约束下更加平衡，提高了平均保留效用，并针对最坏情况的任务退化提供了更强的保护。. Specifically, MtC suffers a sharp collapse on SICK, which both lowers its mean retention and increases its cross-task variability. In contrast, CtM avoids such severe task collapse and produces a more stable retention profile across tasks. This result shows that the subspace learned by CtM is more balanced under the fixed-rank constraint, improving the average retained utility and providing stronger protection against worst-case task degradation.

D.9 多模态任务实验Experiments on Multimodal Tasks

我们还在多模式基准 MM-MergeBench 上评估了 CtMWe additionally evaluate CtM on the multimodal benchmark MM-MergeBench(Zeng et al., 2025)。按照基准设置，我们使用LLaVA-1.5-7B. Following the benchmark setting, we use LLaVA-1.5-7B(Liu et al., 2023)作为基本模型并考虑八个多模式生成任务。这些任务涵盖了多种多模式能力，包括回答问题、基础、分类和字幕。as the base model and consider eight multimodal generative tasks. These tasks cover diverse multimodal abilities, including question answering, grounding, classification, and captioning.

遵循 MM-MergeBench，我们在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上使用特定于任务的 16 级 LoRA，并将 LoRA 模块注入到所有线性层中。我们将八个特定于任务的 LoRA 合并为一个 16 级 LoRA，并根据三个基本合并规则（Iso-C、TIES 和 DARE-TIES）将 CtM 与相应的 MtC 基线进行比较。根据原始基准，我们报告原始精度而不是标准化精度。对于超参数调整，我们随机选择基准测试集的 5% 作为验证集。Following MM-MergeBench, we use task-specific rank-16 LoRAs on LLaVA-1.5-7B, with LoRA modules injected into all linear layers. We merge the eight task-specific LoRAs into a single rank-16 LoRA and compare CtM against the corresponding MtC baselines under three base merge rules: Iso-C, TIES, and DARE-TIES. Following the original benchmark, we report raw accuracies rather than normalized accuracies. For hyperparameter tuning, we randomly select 5% of the benchmark test set to serve as the validation set.
